entities.name: Bjorna, Nightfall Alchemist
entities.description: Legendary human alchemist and Cathar of the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad, a Nightfall Duelist patrolling Nephalia with explosive alchemical vials.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Church whose holy warriors, the Cathars, include Bjorna.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Holy warriors of the Church of Avacyn, trained on the Elgaud Grounds.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region Bjorna patrols at night looking for thieves, vampires and corpse traders.

entities.name: Elgaud Grounds
entities.description: Training ground for Cathar regiments in Nephalia.

relations.note: She is a Cathar of the Church of Avacyn.
relations.quote: Bjorna is a human alchemist and Cathar of the Church of Avacyn
